title: Text: DET Doug Teter ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: He has completed the full rehab protocol, including his full throwing progression, for his UCL reconstruction and has been cleared for baseball activities.  Oof the record, no quitting me, that’s how I would word it.  Like we spoke about before, that doesn’t mean he is going to be ROY form yet as is no other pitcher his first year back from UCL surgery.
Everything is off record. I’m gonna temper things
He’s gonna be feeling himself after everyone talks about how good of shape he’s in.
Yeah he did an amazing job.  Transformed his body to take stress of his legs and be more athletic...total pro during the whole process.
Thanks for getting back to me
No problem.  You have been fair to me.
